The '''Dosk family'''<ref name="Codex" /> was a family that included the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cadmael Benthos Dosk]], who served as a [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Out of the Blue">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Out of the Blue|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref> The family made its fortune in [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing.<ref name="Codex" />
